key_difference: (D) has the same RunFunctionTaskBase destructor as (B), but it also wraps ThreadEngine's initial pool start in a new auto-deleting ThreadEngineStartTask (with a new protected method and a friend declaration) to cover the map()/filter() path; reviewers deliberately left that path out of (B), and in (D) it means threadExit()/finish() and continuations can run from inside QThreadPool::clear(), which is the riskier part.
